decisions.reason: Leaving ESP32 decoupling capacitors C18 and C19 at their existing PCB positions does not change BOM part-number, population, or specification requirements.
The placement decision for ESP32 local decoupling capacitors does not alter the standalone regulator, capacity, activation condition, or source-selection requirements.
The source decision does not change which rails are monitored, the monitoring IC, channel allocation, or measurement coverage.
ESP32 supply-capacitor placement is independent of the GPIO-switched 5V sensor rail and its loads or control topology.
The ESP32 decoupling placement decision does not affect the AXP2101 exposed-pad thermal-transfer requirement.
Leaving C18 and C19 in place does not change the AXP2101 USB, battery, VMID, VSYS, or charging power-path behavior.
The local ESP32 capacitor placement has no effect on the panel-mounted power-button connector or PWRON control behavior.
The source preserves capacitor placement but does not change the DCDC1 configured voltage, target rail voltage, or compensation rule.
The decision about ESP32 decoupling-capacitor distance does not alter high-current trace widths, identified power nets, or copper-current-path requirements.
The source refers specifically to ESP32 decoupling capacitors, not the separate 4.7µF PWM-ripple capacitor in the display-backlight circuit.
The ESP32 decoupling placement decision does not change the battery connector series, pitch, pinout, or mounting type.

Although both requirements concern the ESP32 area, leaving C18 and C19 in their existing positions does not change the module model, pin breakout, pitch, placement flexibility, or full-pin-access requirement.
